items.name: Cradle of Rebirth
items.desc: Rooted deep, this structure metabolizes decaying matter and captured prey into biomass, nourishing the body of the world with every silent pulse.

items.name: Tendril Cradle
items.desc: A cluster of short, rooted threads extend from this site, drawing nearby materials toward key organs in the immediate area.

items.name: Threaded Span
items.desc: Elongated tendrils stretch across the landscape, pulling resources from neighboring expanses before processing and redistributing.

items.name: Conveyroot Nest
items.desc: Braided roots pulse and shift beneath the surface, shuttling biomass through layered channels toward distant biotic hubs.

items.name: Planetary Threadheart
items.desc: Massive logistical tendrils radiate across the planet's body, pulling, pacing, and routing the Wilderness's resources with tireless synchronicity.

items.name: Research Growth
items.desc: The work of playful, exploratory symbionts provides the basis of general research.

items.name: Research Grove
items.desc: A habitat uniquely dedicated to promoting inquisitive behavior, facilitating the study of more advanced artifacts and phenomena.

items.name: Exotic Research Enclosure
items.desc: These sprawling enclosures allow large numbers of extremophile symbionts to experiment with all manner of exotic and dangerous materials.

items.name: Advanced Research Enclosure
items.desc: This fusion of exotic technology and vast, symbiont-grown enclosure facilitates cutting-edge research in a variety of sandbox environments.

items.name: Commensal Clearing
items.desc: These islands of stillness allow motiles of all kinds to gather, rest, and reorient themselves within the Wilderness.

items.name: Commensal Grove
items.desc: Ideal, sheltered venues for mass gatherings of symbionts. Here, their interactions yield further understanding of the distributed self.

items.name: Commensal Valley
items.desc: Dense and highly varied communities of symbionts migrate through these pristine formations, strengthening the ties between each other.

items.name: Commensal Biome
items.desc: Vast, interconnected habitats play host to myriad encounters, each one a vital spark of mutualistic unity.

items.name: Nutritious Dell
items.desc: Small-scale geological sculpturing provides an ideal micro-climate for year-round, reliable crop growth.

items.name: Nutritious Undergrowth
items.desc: A vast, semi-permeable canopy endows this undergrowth with all the environmental protection it needs to consistently produce rich and succulent food.

items.name: Contour Megaplantation
items.desc: A haven for semi-aquatic micro-organisms and fauna alike, these sprawling terraces provide an abundance of protein matter and grains.

items.name: Sylviculture Plantation
items.desc: Arrangements of undergrowth sheltered by leafy megaflora ensure a high yield of food crops to serve the entire food web.

items.name: Chloroplastic Acclimator
items.desc: Clusters of lens-like bubbles focus solar rays inwards through a rich algal soup, converting and storing that energy for later use.

items.name: Chloroplastic Accelerator
items.desc: Glassy bubbles packed full of photosynthesizing algae use solar energy to form tighter bio-chemical bonds, reducing self-discharge.

items.name: Chloroplastic Lens Array
items.desc: Counter-balanced branches laden with solar collectors may rise and fall according to demand and capacity, making for a versatile and reliable power hub.

items.name: Chloroplastic Cyst
items.desc: These glassy, algae-filled sacs may migrate and multiply wherever their energy is most needed, almost eliminating power loss over distance.

items.name: Lithic Bore
items.desc: Plant matter of near-crystalline hardness is forced in and around existing extraction sites, withdrawing even greater yields of useful minerals.

items.name: Lithic Filters
items.desc: Colonies of semi-permeable biofilms collect valuable minerals that would otherwise be lost in run-off from liquid mining operations.

items.name: Lithic Macerator
items.desc: Powerful grinding plates and pincers help reduce earthen matter to a chemical slurry for easier mineral extraction.

items.name: Lithic Baths
items.desc: A concert of macerators, bio-chemical agents, and biofilms permits extraction of minerals on-site, wherever they happens to be a rich seam.

items.name: Smelting Pool
items.desc: Thermophilic symbionts work tirelessly to produce high-quality alloys in and around this natural heat source.

items.name: Smelting Kiln
items.desc: Heat-resistant growths enable more efficient use of heat, and thus the production of superior alloys.

items.name: Solid-Light Smelter
items.desc: Sophisticated litho-organic kilns, aided by hologram technology, enable the production of highly versatile alloys.

items.name: Nano-Smelter
items.desc: Thermophilic nano-organisms inhabit these sweltering pools and kilns, ridding our alloys of unwanted impurities.

items.name: Avatar Cradle
items.desc: A budding organ where the Wilderness begins to shape basic forms. Preparing its instincts for unfamiliar life and terrain beyond its native biosphere.

items.name: Avatar Chamber
items.desc: Simulated bodies are grown and guided through internal trials, mimicking foreign organisms and ecosystems. Knowledge spreads by embodying the unknown.

items.name: Avatar Forest
items.desc: This sprawling organ broadcasts avatar templates shaped after alien forms and landscapes. The Wilderness learns by living what it has never touched.

items.name: Avatar Cortex
items.desc: A planetary-scale engine of embodiment, capable of simulating entire civilizations, xeno-ecologies, and environmental extremes. Here, the Wilderness rehearses its meeting with the galaxy.

items.name: Chemical Digester
items.desc: An elegant system of vascular tissues and chemical metabolizers produces Volatile Motes from everyday earthen matter.

items.name: Exotic Gas Filters
items.desc: Highly specialized microbes and nano-organisms react with mundane aerosols to produce these refined Exotic Gases.

items.name: Crystal Bed
items.desc: Special canopies facilitate the precise humidity and temperature controls required to grow exacting, artificial Rare Crystals.

items.name: Bone Garrison
items.desc: A plethora of fiercely territorial symbionts may be housed in this cocooned proving ground, poised in case they need ever be called upon.

items.name: Bone Fortress
items.desc: This sprawling facility of hardy training grounds and accommodations ensures the defenders housed within are braced for any planetary incursion.

items.name: Planetary Shield Canopy
items.desc: Generating a strong energy shield within a planetary atmosphere is a greater challenge than in the vacuum of space, but it offers a potent defense against orbital bombardment.

items.name: Storm Relief Center
items.desc: A broad canopy of hardened, bioelectrically-charged leaves ensures the safety of symbionts in its vicinity, and allows for rapid responses to cosmic storm activity without endangering life or productivity.

items.name: Subterranean Cache
items.desc: Massive resource silos and storage facilities where large quantities of resources can be safely kept.

items.name: Citadel Uplink
items.desc: This advanced logistics center ensures a constant uplink to any Deep Space Citadel in system.

items.name: Genomic Research Facility
items.desc: Specialized facilities where research into our genetic future is shaped.

items.name: Pinniped Sanctuary
items.desc: A sanctuary for gigantic pinnipeds captured in the liquid nitrogen oceans of [event_target:pinnipeds_home_planet.GetName].

items.name: Cryovault
items.desc: A sealed habitat that utilizes the subthermal dynamics of frozen climates to create a controlled and comfortable living space.

items.name: Bio-Furnace
items.desc: By incorporating significant levels of simulated stellar radiation, this facility is capable of converting biological matter into alloys.

items.name: Leeching Tower
items.desc: These monumental devices are capable of draining excess energies from dedicated populations in close proximity. Assigned individuals wear specialized equipment which funnel their life force into a central conduit where it can then be redistributed to those of higher status.

items.name: Soul Siphon
items.desc: While their name may imply otherwise, Soul Siphons are based in practical science. Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from individuals via physical tether, they are capable of sapping immense amounts of metabolism from organisms without endangering their lives.

items.name: Siphon Battery

items.name: Battery Complex
items.desc: Calibrated specifically to harvest energies from drones via physical tether, these devices are capable of sapping immense amounts of excess processing without inflicting critical faults.

items.name: Experimentation Chambers
items.desc: A top-secret facility for experimenting on incorrigible lawbreakers, mostly comprising prison cells and research laboratories.

items.name: Experimentation Complex
items.desc: A campus of top-secret technology and internment facilities, where lawbreaking [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] are used as subjects in experiments led by the empire's top [Owner.GetResearchers].

items.name: Experimentation Nexus
items.desc: A network of maximum-security technology and internment centers. Teams of elite [Owner.GetResearchers] conduct pioneering experiments on [Owner.GetIndividualNamePlural] drawn from the empire's underworld.

items.name: Sanctum of the Cradle
items.desc: The Sanctum is a place dedicated to communion with the Cradle. [GetCradleSanctumDesc]

items.name: Psionic Suppressor
items.desc: This complex supports an array of long-range psionic attenuators, which dissipate Psionic Auras throughout the star system and prevent their further spread.

items.name: Ancient Ward
items.desc: This ancestral structure uses an array of psionic attenuators to insulate the entire planet against mind-invading forces.

items.name: Grand Ward
items.desc: This ancestral structure has been upgraded with enhanced psionic attenuators, which are capable of protecting against Psionic Auras throughout the star system.

items.name: Materiality Engine
items.desc: The psionic energy of the Shroud adjoins every point in the physical galaxy. The Materiality Engine exploits this interface, making it possible to reach across dimensions and materialize valuable components and resources.

items.name: Chamber of Silence
items.desc: From all across our empire, psionic individuals are brought here to commune with the Shroud in chambers of protective silence.

items.name: Passenger Estates
items.desc: Luxurious manor houses within artificially sculpted landscapes are allocated to the most deserving passengers.

items.name: Paradise Dome
items.desc: A fully enclosed habitation dome with a self-contained ecosystem, a private paradise for those with the proper tickets.

items.name: Voyage Hall
items.desc: Every milestone of the journey is celebrated here, which leaves the passengers thrilled and the supply rooms empty.

items.name: Enrichment Labs
items.desc: Luxury cabins retooled as classrooms and labs turn passengers into active partners in science.

items.name: Indulgence Reprocessors
items.desc: A vast complex where waste becomes wonder, unseen by the passengers.

items.name: Service Workshops
items.desc: Workshops that streamline the daily labor behind food and power alike.

items.name: Crew Coordination Center
items.desc: Schedules synchronize, workflows tighten, and output rises under coordinated oversight.

items.name: Holo-Production Studios
items.desc: Endless sets and soundstages, where the crew churns out passenger fantasies on demand.
